label: EltonTraits 1.0: species-level foraging attributes of the world's birds and mammals
bibliographic_citation: Wilman H, Belmaker J, Simpson J, de la Rosa C, Rivadeneira MM, Jetz W (2014) EltonTraits 1.0: Species-level foraging attributes of the world's birds and mammals. Ecology 95:2027. Ecological Archives E095-178.
license: CC0 1.0 (Wiley figshare mirror of Ecological Archives E095-178)

counts.description: Count standardized 2026-10-31 by the holdout thread after re-downloading the file (same sha256): distinct scientific names in BirdFuncDat.txt that carry a Diet-5Cat value (the paper's bird species count); the file also has 10203 rows with a SpecID, of which 10011 carry a scientific name, plus 2 blank tab-only lines
Count standardized 2026-10-31 by the holdout thread after re-downloading the file (same sha256): rows in BirdFuncDat.txt with a non-empty SpecID

Count standardized 2026-10-31 by the holdout thread after re-downloading the file (same sha256): rows in MamFuncDat.txt with a non-empty MSW3_ID and scientific name (the file ends with 3 blank tab-only lines, which earlier counts of 5403 included)
species-level taxa of this slice with one row each (mammals + birds)
mammal rows in genus-level taxa (ateles: 7, globicephala: 2)

measurement_technique: Literature-compiled diet composition, foraging stratum, activity period and body mass (BodyMass-Value, g) per species.
role: body mass and foraging attributes for the listed birds and mammals
